newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hutchinson Tech Q1 EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hutchinson Tech Q1 EPS raised.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities analyst Paul Fox said on Tuesday he raised his earnings estimate for Hutchinson Technology for the first quarter ending in December to $1.78 per share from $0.67.
-- He also said he raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to a net $6 from $3.10.
-- Fox said he looked for second-quarter EPS of $1.30, third-quarter of $1.35 and $1.57 for the fourth quarter.

-- Earlier on Tuesday, Hutchinson, which makes suspension assemblies for disk drives, said it expects first-quarter earnings of between $1.50 and $1.90 per share versus $0.51 year-ago after a $0.69 per share charge.
-- "It's strong demand leading to better cost-absorption leading to higher gross margin leading to higher EPS," Fox said.
-- Fox said his rating for Hutchinson remained unchanged at a hold.
